accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Candidates events 2026:
1. The Open Candidates tournament was won by Javokhir Sindarov.
2. The Women's Candidates tournament was won by R. Vaishali.
3. R. Vaishali became the first Indian woman to win the Candidates tournament.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Sindarov won the Open Candidates, while R. Vaishali won the Women's Candidates and became the first Indian woman to do so in its 74-year history.
accepted.tq: Check each statement separately before selecting the complete combination.
accepted.sec: Chess - World Championship, Olympiad, World Cup, rapid/blitz, Tata Steel  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
With reference to the 46th Chess Olympiad, consider the following statements:
1. India is the defending champion in both the Open and Women's sections.
2. The Olympiad is scheduled to be held at Samarkand.
3. Indian men are seeded first and Indian women second.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Indian men are seeded second and Indian women first, so statement 3 reverses the seeding positions.
accepted.tq: Spot the reversed comparison in the seeding statement.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the Indian performance at the FIDE World Rapid 2025 in Doha?
o: Koneru Humpy and R. Praggnanandhaa won gold medals; Praggnanandhaa became the second Indian man on the podium.
Koneru Humpy and Arjun Erigaisi won bronze medals; Arjun became the second Indian man to reach the podium after Anand.
R. Vaishali and D. Gukesh won bronze medals; Gukesh became the first Indian man on the podium.
Divya Deshmukh and Arjun Erigaisi won silver medals; Arjun became the third Indian man on the podium.
accepted.x: Koneru Humpy and Arjun Erigaisi won bronze medals at Doha in 2025. Arjun was the second Indian man on the podium after Viswanathan Anand.
accepted.tq: Compare the medal colour, players and historical podium position in one precise option.
accepted.sec: Chess - World Championship, Olympiad, World Cup, rapid/blitz, Tata Steel  [APPSC]
